stemMd: An upright right circular cone is cut by a horizontal plane halfway between its base and apex. What shape is the section?
explanationMd: Every horizontal plane inside an upright right circular cone is parallel to the base. Similarity gives a smaller circle; at half the height its radius is half the base radius. The question asks shape rather than size.

distractorRationale.e: A plane parallel to the circular base preserves circular symmetry.
distractorRationale.c: A triangular section requires an axial plane through the apex.
distractorRationale.b: The cutting plane is not parallel to a generator.
distractorRationale.d: The cone has no rectangular horizontal cross-section.
